This slider allows you to set the duration of a tap - that is, the amount of time between a simulated finger moving up and down. For example, if set to 100, it will simulate the finger pointing up 100 milliseconds after the finger lowered for each click. You should not set the value below 100 because it will increase the possibility of being banned.

This slider allows you to set the amount of time between each press. For example, if set to 100, there will be a 100ms delay after each tap before the next tap is triggered. You should not bet below 100 because it will increase the possibility of being banned

When this switch is on, pressing the binding button while releasing the rocker will reactivate the switch. If you find that the joystick does not move after turning it on or off, turn this switch on. And set the latency to be slightly larger than your average network latency.

When this switch is turned on, the virtual finger simulating viewpoint control will be raised and pressed again when the link button is pressed simultaneously. And set the latency to be slightly larger than your average network latency.

This option sets the number of recognition attempts per second. The higher the value, the faster the recognition but can cause the device to heat up and reduce FPS. Low values help reduce device load, but recognition may be slow. High performance devices should increase this option, low performance devices should decrease it. For example, machines with performance like Red Magic 8 or higher can be set to high or extremely high, weaker machines should be set to low or medium.

"“Reduced threshold when weapons are not detected; Increase threshold if misidentified (e.g. Scar to M4). Recommended value: 50–80. If below 50 is still not recognized, follow the steps below: 1. Check whether the size of the white icon in the weapon identification frame matches the size of the M4 in the game; The positions do not need to be the same. 2. Check whether the upper left corner of the weapon recognition frame matches the upper left corner of the weapon frame in the game."

Reduced threshold when Scope is not recognized; increase threshold if misidentification (e.g. 6x to 8x). Recommended value: 60–80. If it is still not recognized below 50, check whether the size of the white part in the magnified recognition frame matches the 2x Scope in the game (the position does not need to be the same).
